title: Rasmus Lerdorf - 25 Years of PHP - phpday 2019
summary: Rasmus Lerdorf marks 25 years of PHP at phpday 2019 with a look at the highlights and lowlights of the language. He argues for upgrading PHP versions, covering performance, static analysis, zero-cost profiling and dead code elimination.
why: HN uses it as the primary source for PHP's origins as a templating system for C and for the story behind its inconsistent function design.

quote.text: have a look at this talk[1] by Rasmus Lerdorf about its creation.
